input.prompt: 3D-rendered scene with an American comic book finish: physically modelled materials and depth like a Spider-Verse frame, then bold black ink contour lines on edges and Ben-Day halftone dots only inside the shadows. A horse racing home straight seen from slightly above the outside rail: the raked brown dirt track fills the lower two thirds of the frame and runs straight across the whole width with faint hoof-print furrows, a white wooden inside rail across the upper third, a green infield hedge, and in the top band an old wooden grandstand under a gold and green sunset sky. Empty, no horses. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no writing anywhere.
